# App data schema (generated file; do not edit by hand)

Generated by `python3 -I scripts/generate_data_schema_doc.py` from the files in `UI/data_real/`. Rules for using these files are in `docs/APP_IMPLEMENTATION_CONTRACT.md`. Every file is real data or derived from real data; none is synthetic. A file marked optional exists only if its real source was obtained.

## `bias_by_month.csv` (required)

- Grain: month
- Content: NASA minus Yellowknife A mean bias by calendar month with station mean temperature.
- Display limitation: Source of the required bias caveat.
- Rows: 12

| Column | dtype |
|---|---|
| month | int64 |
| n | int64 |
| mean_bias | float64 |
| median_bias | float64 |
| sd | float64 |
| bias_tmax | float64 |
| bias_tmin | float64 |
| station_mean_t | float64 |

## `canonical_facts.json` (required)

- Grain: single object
- Content: Machine-readable canonical numbers (status counts, periods, bias, headline trends, caveat text) generated from the data.
- Display limitation: Use for text; tables and charts should read the CSVs.

## `climate_annual.csv` (required)

- Grain: corridor x winter x metric (fdd, thaw_days), 2 primary corridors
- Content: NASA POWER per-winter FDD (Oct-Dec) and thaw days (Jan-Mar) with coverage counts. Source: NASA POWER daily T2M (MERRA-2).
- Display limitation: Reanalysis, colder than the station; thaw_days is mostly zeros and has no trend estimate.
- Rows: 96

| Column | dtype |
|---|---|
| corridor_id | str |
| season_year | int64 |
| metric | str |
| value | float64 |
| n_days | int64 |
| missing_days | int64 |
| synthetic | bool |

## `corridor_panel.csv` (required)

- Grain: 9 corridors
- Content: Compact slope/p panel for the nine corridors (2001-2024).

| open_to_close_days_p | float64 |
| n_road_seasons | int64 |

## `corridors.csv` (required)

- Grain: one row per selectable location
- Content: Location ids, names and coordinates. `kind` is a data class (verified = has real road records), NOT a statement that the route identity is verified. The `custom` row has no data and must not be offered as a data location.
- Display limitation: Aklavik point is a calculated midpoint; supplementary corridors are approximate.
- Rows: 3

| Column | dtype |
|---|---|
| corridor_id | str |
| name | str |
| kind | str |
| lat | float64 |
| lon | float64 |
| has_road_records | bool |

- Display limitation: Operations record, not ice measurement.
- Rows: 64

| season_year | int64 |
| open_date | str |
| close_date | str |
| season_length_days | int64 |
| synthetic | bool |
